command:
cd /home/starryreverie/userdata/development/rCore-Tutorial-Code-2026A/os && cat > /tmp/gdbtest.cmd <<'EOF'
set pagination off
set confirm off
set architecture riscv:rv64
set language rust
target remote localhost:1234
break os::mm::memory_set::MemorySet::new_kernel
continue
bt 5
info args
info registers satp
quit
EOF
pkill -f qemu-system-riscv64 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
make gdbserver MODE=debug BASE=2 >/tmp/qemu-gdbserver.log 2>&1 &
QPID=$!
sleep 3
timeout 60 gdb -nx -q -batch -x /tmp/gdbtest.cmd target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/debug/os 2>&1 | tail -40
kill $QPID 2>/dev/null; pkill -f qemu-system-riscv64 2>/dev/null
echo "done"
